raw_html: [[Greater Flaming Blast]][[File:Icon tooltip.png|link=|super|10px]]'''[[Greater Flaming Blast]]:''' A flaming blast weapon is sheathed in fire. Critical hits with this weapon deal an additional 4 to 40 fire damage for weapons with a x2 critical multiplier, 6 to 60 for a x3 critical multiplier, and 8 to 80 for a x4 multiplier. Additionally, if you roll a 20 when attacking and confirm the critical hit, the weapon blasts your target, doing 6 to 36 more fire damage.
